CAR-T therapy redirects a patient's own T cells against a tumor antigen, and
has been the primary target in B-cell malignancies.
Durable remission is achieved in only a subset of patients — roughly 40 percent at two years in the pivotal trials.
Give only the background needed to judge this paper's claim; if your lab already works here, two sentences is plenty.
